notes.title: NEW DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627086/5d9f861e50e9bea36ee34321ccd74a2beec11154.gif[/img]
[h1]THE NEW DEMO HAS LANDED[/h1]

Diner Managers of the Galaxy,

We're very excited to announce that a new demo is out! After more than a year of further development, we've got an advanced beta that's ready to be tried out — most of the major features are now available for you to experience.

Here are the demo's limitations:
[list]
[*] The demo lasts 2 in-game years, after which the game will automatically end.
[*] Special rooms are locked — they'll play an important role in generating money and visitor satisfaction in the later stages of the main game.
[*] The Expeditions feature is locked — we're still fine-tuning it!
[/list]
Also, please note that you may encounter some weird bugs or imperfections in the art and audio assets. We're working on those.

We would really appreciate it if you reported any bugs you find. Head over to the discussion board — you'll see a pinned post where we explain how to locate your game logs and saves, which are reeeaaally helpful in fixing the issues you encounter.

And lastly — if you like this little preview, please share and pass it on. Add us to your wishlist and spread the word on your socials!

We hope you enjoy it, and we're looking forward to hearing your feedback.

[h3]THE GENERAL INTERACTIVE TEAM[/h3]
